phases.name: Warm-Up — Bike or Rower
phases.goal: One machine, one purpose — get the body temperature up before loading it. Keep it easy. This is not the workout.

tip.label: Pace:
tip.text: RPE 5 — comfortable, conversational. Gradually increase resistance every 2 minutes. Finish with 1 minute at a moderate push, then step off and go straight to the floor.

phases.name: Circuit 1 — Lower Body Power
phases.goal: Kettlebell-driven lower body circuit. Move fast between exercises, rest only at the end of the full round. 3 rounds total.

tip.label: Form:
tip.text: Hinge at the hips — not a squat. Drive the hips forward explosively. The bell should float to chest height. Keep the core braced throughout.

tip.label: Tempo:
tip.text: 2 seconds down, explode up. Hold the dumbbell at chest height. Elbows inside the knees at the bottom.

tip.label: Rest:
tip.text: 60 seconds after completing all 3 exercises then repeat. Keep rest between exercises to zero.

phases.name: Circuit 2 — Upper Body Conditioning
phases.goal: Dumbbell upper body circuit. Keep the weights moderate — this is cardiovascular work, not max strength. Speed matters.

tip.label: Form:
tip.text: Plank position, feet wide for stability. Row one dumbbell at a time, keeping hips square. No rocking.

tip.label: Drive:
tip.text: Slight dip at the knees then drive the dumbbells overhead using leg momentum. This is what makes it cardio — the full body drive.

tip.label: Rest:
tip.text: 60 seconds after completing all 3 exercises then repeat. Keep a flat back — hinge to 45 degrees and pull elbows back.

phases.name: Circuit 3 — Full Body Burners
phases.goal: The hardest block. Full body compound movements with minimal rest. Heart rate will spike — push through it.

tip.label: Movement:
tip.text: Clean the bell to rack position at the shoulder, then press overhead. One fluid motion — clean and press without pausing too long at rack.

tip.label: Flow:
tip.text: Dumbbells at shoulders, squat deep, drive up and press overhead in one continuous motion. Use the momentum from the squat — no pause at the top.

tip.label: Balance:
tip.text: Stand on one leg, hinge forward with the bell in the opposite hand. Targets glutes and hamstrings hard. Keep a proud chest and slow the eccentric down.

phases.name: Finisher — KB Complex
phases.goal: One round, no rest between movements. Pick one kettlebell and don't put it down until the complex is done.

tip.label: Finisher:
tip.text: No rest between any of these. One continuous flow. This is the last thing you do — leave nothing in the tank.

cards.title: Static Stretching — 5 min
cards.desc: Hip flexors, hamstrings, lats, shoulders. Hold each 30–40 seconds. You hit the full body today.

cards.title: Hydration & Protein
cards.desc: Weighted cardio burns glycogen fast. Prioritize protein and fast carbs within 45 minutes post-session.
